what_was_measured: The relationship-graph fusion branch, scored with the deterministic offline harness (bm25 + trigram + graph legs over the recorded corpus artifacts, production reciprocal_rank_fusion). The 'graph' leg is the OFFLINE PROXY for the live Graphiti read: an entity-anchor ranking (multi-word capitalized query spans matched as chunk substrings) standing in for the relationship-graph's entity-connected chunk retrieval. The proxy is deterministic and recorded; a live-graph measurement against a seeded Graphiti remains the follow-up before any default-on flip.
measured_weight_rationale: argmax of the sweep on all three recorded metrics (recall@10, MRR, nDCG@10); every point above 0.1 degrades at least one metric relative to it, and w_graph=0 (branch absent) is dominated on all three.
decision: RRF_WEIGHT_GRAPHITI = 0.1 in src/app/features/documents/domain/constants.py. The branch REMAINS DEFAULT-OFF (DOCUMENTS_GRAPHITI_FUSION_ENABLED=False); flipping default-on is a later change that cites this report per the graph-fusion-branch spec.
